LI4.name: He Gu
LI4.location: In the webbing between the thumb and index finger, at the highest point of the muscle when they are pressed together.
LI4.technique: Pinch the webbing between your opposite thumb and index finger. Press firmly toward the bone of the index finger. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.
LI4.caution: Avoid during pregnancy — this point is traditionally used to promote labour.

GB20.name: Feng Chi
GB20.location: In the two hollows at the base of the skull, between the two vertical neck muscles, about two finger-widths out from the spine.
GB20.technique: Interlock your fingers behind your head and press your thumbs upward and inward into the hollows. Let your head tip back into the pressure. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

PC6.name: Nei Guan
PC6.location: On the inner forearm, two thumb-widths above the wrist crease, in the dip between the two central tendons.
PC6.technique: Press with the thumb of your opposite hand, straight down between the tendons. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

ST36.name: Zu San Li
ST36.location: On the outer front of the shin, four finger-widths below the kneecap and one finger-width out from the shin bone.
ST36.technique: Press with your thumb or knuckle into the muscle beside the bone. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

SP6.name: San Yin Jiao
SP6.location: On the inner lower leg, four finger-widths above the inner ankle bone, just behind the edge of the shin bone.
SP6.technique: Press with your thumb into the soft tissue behind the bone. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.
SP6.caution: Avoid during pregnancy — this point is traditionally used to promote labour.

LU7.name: Lie Que
LU7.location: On the thumb side of the forearm, about one and a half thumb-widths above the wrist crease, just above the bony bump.
LU7.technique: Angle the opposite thumb up toward the elbow and press against the bone. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

LU9.name: Tai Yuan
LU9.location: On the wrist crease on the thumb side, in the hollow beside the pulse.
LU9.technique: Press gently with the opposite thumb, beside the artery rather than on it. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

HT7.name: Shen Men
HT7.location: On the wrist crease on the little-finger side, in the hollow just inside the tendon.
HT7.technique: Press with the opposite thumb into the small hollow. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

TE5.name: Wai Guan
TE5.location: On the back of the forearm, two thumb-widths above the wrist crease, midway between the two bones.
TE5.technique: Press with the opposite thumb straight into the gap between the bones. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

SI3.name: Hou Xi
SI3.location: On the edge of the palm below the little finger, in the crease that appears when you make a loose fist.
SI3.technique: Make a loose fist and press into the crease with the opposite thumb. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

LI11.name: Qu Chi
LI11.location: At the outer end of the elbow crease, found with the elbow bent to a right angle.
LI11.technique: Bend the elbow and press into the end of the crease with the opposite thumb. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

GB21.name: Jian Jing
GB21.location: On the top of the shoulder, at the highest point of the muscle midway between the base of the neck and the tip of the shoulder.
GB21.technique: Hook your opposite hand over the shoulder and squeeze the muscle between fingers and palm. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.
GB21.caution: Avoid during pregnancy — this point is traditionally used to promote labour.

GV20.name: Bai Hui
GV20.location: At the very top of the head, on the midline, level with the tips of the ears.
GV20.technique: Press straight down with the pad of the middle finger. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

EX-HN5.name: Tai Yang
EX-HN5.location: In the soft hollow of the temple, about one finger-width back from the outer corner of the eye.
EX-HN5.technique: Press with the pads of both index fingers and make small slow circles. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

EX-HN3.name: Yin Tang
EX-HN3.location: On the midline of the forehead, directly between the inner ends of the eyebrows.
EX-HN3.technique: Press with the pad of one thumb and hold, breathing out slowly. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

BL40.name: Wei Zhong
BL40.location: In the centre of the crease at the back of the knee.
BL40.technique: Sit with the knee bent and press into the centre of the crease with both thumbs. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

BL57.name: Cheng Shan
BL57.location: In the middle of the back of the calf, in the inverted V where the calf muscle ends.
BL57.technique: Press into the notch with both thumbs while the calf is relaxed. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.

LR3.name: Tai Chong
LR3.location: On the top of the foot, in the valley between the big toe and second toe, about two finger-widths back from the web.
LR3.technique: Slide your thumb back from the web until it settles in the valley, then press down. Press for 3 seconds, release for 1 second.
